name: Princess Leia
description: From a plush little blue fluff at 12 weeks to a graceful, full-grown female at 12 months and beyond, Princess Leia has matured beautifully. Her blue solid coat has deepened into a rich, even shade, giving her a soft, polished look that feels both elegant and distinctive. As a kitten, she already had a lovely expression and a quiet charm, and those qualities have only become more refined with age. Her progression captures that wonderful Maine Coon transformation, growing from a sweet, cuddly youngster into a composed and striking young lady with real presence.
